title: Overlay populations on fitness contours
description: You compare saved populations against the same fitness contours.
source: draft: codex free model + edit: codex

steps.description: You create a coordinate grid within bounds using the supplied resolution. Each ZZ entry stores fitness at its coordinate pair.
You draw filled fitness contours and place the population's coordinates on top. The helper applies the same bounds to every panel.

steps.question: What determines the order of the saved generations shown across the panels?
steps.answer: sorted(snap_pop.keys()) orders the generation keys. The loop pairs those generations with axes and matching titles.

steps.description: You display three population panels and print the stored best result. The recording reports [0., -0.] with fitness -0.0, alongside the stated optimum at (0,0).
